create_atoms_table_from_arrays: create an Atoms table from numpy arrays of chain keys, residue keys, coordinates, and b-factors
create_residues_table_from_defaults: create a Residues table with default names and insertion codes from residue IDs and chain keys
create_chains_table_from_defaults: create a Chains table with default protein chain types from chain IDs and entity descriptions
build_structure_tables_from_atom_arrays: build Atoms, Residues, and Chains tables from raw atom-level numpy arrays including coordinates and residue IDs
convert_tables_to_mmcif_atom_site: convert Atoms, Residues, Chains, and Bonds tables into raw mmCIF _atom_site and _struct_conn dictionary entries
